Point body_path at the trial snapshot tree. Deduplicate daily Transaction-in-Own-Shares before counting filing coverage. Reject Google News hits whose issuer is ASX:IMB (Intelligent Monitoring Group).

appended.name: Imperial Brands PLC
appended.suggestion: Fail-closed or flag when screening_snapshot.fcf.currency is USD on a GBP LSE reporter, and set fcf_definition_divergence whenever screen_ttm (2,502m) disagrees with filing_aligned (3,166m). Do not pass quality/GARP/Buffett on 37% ROE while earnings growth is negative and book equity is shrinking via buybacks. Enable a tobacco-excise overlay so current-ratio < 2 is not treated as ordinary industrial illiquidity without netting duty payables, and surface dual leverage when D/E > 200% even if leases are small.

appended.name: Imperial Brands PLC
appended.suggestion: Filings-first order is adequate in principle (70/71 bodies present) but not in practice for IMB.L: all 8 period=annual hits are Companies House group accounts (2019–2026 filings), interim=0 and trading_update=0, and the 63 period=other items are almost entirely Transaction-in-Own-Shares plus TVR/holdings/PDMR. yahoo_quarterly_cashflow is on the ladder but empty (TTM suppressed); alternate_news and ir_presentation_metrics are dead/absent steps. H1 2026, Black Buffalo, and the August jobs/savings plan therefore fall through to headline-only news, which the ladder ranks below empty quarterlies.

appended.name: Imperial Brands PLC
appended.suggestion: Four worker types plus a five-task cap would normally force annual+interim+news+screen+gap. Here there is no tagged interim body, so a second summarize_filing_body cannot be assigned without inventing a source or smuggling a buyback RNS. summarize_filing_body cannot carry period=annual|interim|trading_update|corporate_action, and there is no type to cluster ~50 own-share RNSs, parse an IR deck, or reconcile the 2,502m vs 3,166m FCF bases. gap_inventory can only list the missing H1/IR/NGP bodies — it cannot fill them.

appended.name: Imperial Brands PLC
appended.suggestion: The screen emits strong_buy (13/22, five families including quality/GARP/dividend) while earnings growth is negative, D/E is 244%, current ratio is 0.74, Piotroski is 6/9, and Financial Health/Moat/Graham fail. Overlays are all false: fcf_basis_overlay despite 2,502m vs 3,166m FCF, leverage_override/dual_leverage_display despite net debt 8.2bn, dividend_yield_overlay on a 6.5% levered tobacco yield, cash_conversion_overlay, and cyclical_exposure on a secular volume-decline staple. Quality/Buffett can pass on 37% ROE created by shrinking book equity. The director–worker loop is being asked to qualitatively veto a mechanically clean headline that sector/leverage/FCF overlays failed to brake.

appended.name: Imperial Brands PLC
appended.suggestion: weeks_at_signal=1 / stability=new / conviction=0.454 already mark a fresh print, but there is no watch schema for: ingest of the missing H1 2026 statutory RNS, remaining £1.45bn buyback capacity versus live prints versus the £2,496.78/£2,395.90 ladder, Black Buffalo close/integration, job-cut cash costs versus the £320m-by-2030 savings claim, FY2026 outlook checkpoints, or UK generational-ban / NGP regulation. RSI 38 + below-SMA200 timing is not a substitute for those monitors.

appended.name: Imperial Brands PLC
appended.suggestion: A generic FINANCIAL REVIEW / RISKS split will blend duty-paid revenue with tobacco net revenue and will not force combustibles volume/price versus NGP, statutory versus adjusted, excise-distorted working capital, or company versus IFRS-16 net debt. Without explicit CAPITAL RETURNS, NGP TRANSITION, and LITIGATION/REGULATION slots, workers will treat the daily £1.45bn buyback flood and Kalkine income pieces as colour. No required slot for reporting-currency hygiene (snapshot USD vs sterling accounts) or for ‘H1 exists only in news’. Director catalog pass can form these questions without drafting the memo.
